title: Periplus descriptions file
description: The hand-written .periplus/descriptions.yaml beside the map: what a node or edge does, and where the reader read it.

nodes.description: Node id, as the map writes it, to its entry.

edges.description: Edge entries, each keyed by the edge's from, kind and to as the map writes them, so an entry survives a new map run while that edge is in it. periplus show prints an edge's entry under its row, and periplus find lists an edge whose text holds the words searched. periplus stamp, stale and undescribed read node entries only.

fingerprint.description: Written by periplus stamp: the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the code the entry describes. periplus stale compares it with the code now.
